en.title: oa
en.summary: This is the letter L320 from the vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters oa
paragraphs: The letters oa sound like (oak) /oʊk/, a large tree. This pair has two different sounds.

sections.title: How to say oa
paragraphs: For the first sound, start with the tongue back and mid. Glide to close while your lips make a circle. A diphthong has two vowel sounds in one syllable. Touch your throat to feel it shake. For the second sound, pull your tongue back, keep your mouth open, and hold the voice steady.

sections.title: Spelling patterns
paragraphs: In most words, the letters oa make the sound in (boat) /boʊt/. When the letter r follows, you hear the longer sound in (roar) /rɔːr/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say a short single sound like in pot. The first sound glides, as in (road) /roʊd/. Before the letter r, do not glide, but keep the open vowel steady, as in (board) /bɔːrd/.
